historical_echoes.quote: The 'Fifth Column' of wreckers and spies must be liquidated to protect the revolution from capitalist encirclement.
historical_echoes.analogy_link: Both use the fear of 'unseen' internal enemies funded by distant powers to justify crackdowns.

rhetorical_tropes.theme: The Cult of the Infallible Leader

historical_echoes.quote: The force at the core leading our cause forward is the Chinese Communist Party. The theoretical basis guiding our thinking is Marxism-Leninism.
historical_echoes.analogy_link: Focuses on the Leader/Party as the sole source of truth and survival.

historical_echoes.quote: Fascism is a religious conception in which man is seen in his immanent relationship with a higher law and an objective Will.
historical_echoes.analogy_link: Frame political obedience as a moral or spiritual duty to the state.
